name: orch
description: Project-agnostic orchestration loop: pick tasks from a canonical task store, delegate implementation + verification to subagents, gate every acceptance criterion on tool evidence, round-cap the fix loop, and open draft PRs. Config-driven via .orch/config.md. Run /orch (or /orch:init first). The hooks module guards the main loop on Fable (tool.call), opens a settings pane (/orch panel) and exports $.orch.

guard.title: Main-loop guard
guard.description: When the main loop is held to planning and delegating: on a Fable model, always, or never.

allow_fable_agents.title: Allow Fable subagents
allow_fable_agents.description: Let the main loop spawn a subagent on an explicit Fable model (the person asked for it).

implementer_ctx_k.title: Implementer context cap (k tokens)
implementer_ctx_k.description: Reuse an implementer for a fix round only while its context is under this many thousand tokens.

ui_review.title: UI review
ui_review.description: Run ui-reviewer without asking when the project config declares a web capability.

inject_rules.title: Inject orchestrator rules
inject_rules.description: Print ORCHESTRATOR.md into the main session at session start (the SessionStart hook).

rounds.title: Fix rounds
rounds.description: Fix rounds per task; --rounds overrides it for one run.
